WitchDoctorWidowmakers.name: Widowmakers
WitchDoctorWidowmakers.description: Enemies hit by Corpse Spiders' jar are Slowed by 25% for 1 second. Reward: After Corpse Spiders attack Heroes 100 times, their attack damage is increased by 25% and their duration is increased by 1 second.

WitchDoctorPandemic.name: Pandemic
WitchDoctorPandemic.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Plague of Toads. Reward: After hitting 35 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it spawns 2 additional toads. Reward: After hitting 70 Heroes with Plague of Toads, it reduces the damage Heroes deal by 5%, stacking up to 25%.

WitchDoctorThingOfTheDeep.name: Thing of the Deep
WitchDoctorThingOfTheDeep.description: Increase the range of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 20%. Reward: After gaining 50 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain 5% Spell Power. Reward: After gaining 100 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, gain an additional 5% Spell Power.

WitchDoctorHexedCrawlers.name: Hexed Crawlers
WitchDoctorHexedCrawlers.description: Corpse Spiders restore 1% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana when they attack an enemy Hero.

WitchDoctorBigVoodoo.name: Big Voodoo
WitchDoctorBigVoodoo.description: Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.

WitchDoctorBloodRitual.name: Blood Ritual
WitchDoctorBloodRitual.description: If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana. Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.

WitchDoctorSpiritofArachyr.name: Spirit of Arachyr
WitchDoctorSpiritofArachyr.description: The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.

WitchDoctorDeadRush.name: Dead Rush
WitchDoctorDeadRush.description: Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies for 3 seconds.

WitchDoctorToadsofHugeness.name: Toads of Hugeness
WitchDoctorToadsofHugeness.description: Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.

WitchDoctorHeroicAbilityGargantuan.name: Gargantuan
WitchDoctorHeroicAbilityGargantuan.description: Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area for 20 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 140 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

WitchDoctorHeroicAbilityRavenousSpirits.name: Ravenous Spirit
WitchDoctorHeroicAbilityRavenousSpirits.description: Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.

WitchDoctorGuardianToads.name: Guardian Toads
WitchDoctorGuardianToads.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.

WitchDoctorSuperstition.name: Superstition
WitchDoctorSuperstition.description: Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.

GenericTalentIceBlock.name: Ice Block
GenericTalentIceBlock.description: Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.

WitchDoctorSpiderColony.name: Spider Colony
WitchDoctorSpiderColony.description: Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.

WitchDoctorRingOfPoison.name: Ring of Poison
WitchDoctorRingOfPoison.description: Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.

WitchDoctorSoulHarvest.name: Soul Harvest
WitchDoctorSoulHarvest.description: Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.

WitchDoctorHumongoid.name: Humongoid
WitchDoctorHumongoid.description: Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%. Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.

WitchDoctorAnnihilatingSpirits.name: Annihilating Spirit
WitchDoctorAnnihilatingSpirits.description: When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration. Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.

WitchDoctorVileInfection.name: Vile Infection
WitchDoctorVileInfection.description: Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual. Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 67 (+4% per level) to 167 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.

WitchDoctorBadMedicine.name: Bad Medicine
WitchDoctorBadMedicine.description: Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.
